recognize_zh: 整片紅血球大小形狀差異極大：可見低色素細胞、標靶細胞、帶棘狀突起的棘形與皺縮紅血球、碎片，且多顆紅血球內有深紫色圓點的 Howell-Jolly 小體（提示脾切除或脾功能低下），符合重型 β 型地中海貧血的抹片。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with hypochromic and microcytic red cells
Target cells and hypochromic cells with irregular central pallor
Numerous spiculated cells (acanthocytes and echinocytes) and red cell fragments
Multiple Howell-Jolly bodies (single dense purple inclusions) suggesting hyposplenism
Scattered platelets; no nucleated red cells clearly seen in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with a dimorphic-appearing red cell population. There are numerous hypochromic microcytes, target cells, spiculated cells (acanthocytes and echinocytes), and fragmented forms, together with polychromatic cells. Many red cells contain Howell-Jolly bodies, raising the possibility of prior splenectomy or functional hyposplenism. Findings are consistent with severe thalassemia such as beta-thalassemia major in the appropriate clinical and hemoglobin analysis context; transfused donor cells may account for the normal-appearing population.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps with target cells and microcytosis; hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC showing HbE is required for separation.
HbH disease shows similar hypochromic poikilocytes but HbH inclusions ('golf ball' cells) appear on supravital brilliant cresyl blue staining.
Iron deficiency produces pencil cells and hypochromia but lacks the extreme poikilocytosis, numerous target cells, and Howell-Jolly bodies; iron studies are low.
Howell-Jolly bodies, acanthocytes, and target cells occur after splenectomy alone, but without the marked hypochromic microcytosis of thalassemia.
